question.text: In India, the first exchange-traded currency option was launched on which pair and in which year?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 87 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) identifies USDINR as the first exchange-traded currency option launched in India, in 2010. Cross-currency options were launched subsequently, but the workbook does not give a specific year for them on page 87. The Trap: 2008 was the year currency futures (not options) launched. EURINR and USDINR 2012 do not match the first-option-pair fact on page 87. Note: Page 49 supports 2018 as the launch year for cross-currency futures; that 2018 date applies to futures, not to options, and is not used here as an option launch year.
